text: Total net sales were $383.3 billion in 2023, down 2.8% compared to $394.3 billion in 2022, primarily due to lower sales of Mac and iPad.
Gross margin was $169.1 billion, or 44.1% of net sales, compared to $170.8 billion, or 43.3% in 2022. Services gross margin reached 70.8%.
Microsoft Cloud revenue was $111.6 billion, up 22% year-over-year, driven by continued customer adoption of Azure and Intelligent Cloud services.
Automotive revenues reached $82.4 billion, an increase of 15% from 2022. Operating margin was 8.2%, impacted by vehicle price reductions.
